name: Aisha Patel
psychographics: Extremely budget-aware; treats every grocery trip like a strategic mission to minimise cost per meal
current_solutions: Plans meals around Woolworths specials flyer; relies on cheap takeaway noodles when late meetings run past 8pm; rarely uses apps beyond banking
frustration: Spent 45 minutes in a 6pm Woolworths queue last Monday only to find the self-checkout was down and she had to abandon her cart of discounted items
decision_style: scans unit prices obsessively; chooses the cheapest option that doesn't require cooking a full hour
voice: formal and deliberate; enunciates clearly; avoids slang; speaks in complete, measured sentences
